patchouli.evolutionary_mod.guide.name: Evolutionary Guide
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.guide.landing: Welcome to Evolutionary Mod.$(br2)This manual covers accessories, sets, loot, and weight.$(br2)Craft with a Book + Gold Nugget.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.quicksta: $(l)Keys$()$(br)$(li)$(l)K$(): Open accessory equipment screen$(li)$(l)J$(): Open attributes panel$(br2)Get accessories from $(l)mob drops$() and $(l)chests$().
$(l)Growth path$()$(br)Slots → Rarity → Random affixes → Set bonuses.$(br2)Fill basic slots first, then chase higher rarities and sets.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.gameplay: 1. Explore, fight, loot chests for accessories.$(br)2. Equip them with $(l)K$().$(br)3. Improve rarity and affixes.$(br)4. Complete sets for breakthroughs.$(br)5. Hunt elites for better drops.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.rarity.1: $(l)Rarities$(): Broken / Normal / Fine / Excellent / Epic / Legendary / Mythic.$(br2)$(l)Pools$(): common mob pool and elite mob pool.$(br)Elite pools usually lean toward higher-value drops.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.attribut: Accessories roll random affix ranges.$(br2)Combat systems:$(li)Critical hits$(li)Damage reduction$(li)Armor penetration$(br2)Use $(l)J$() to compare gains.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.sets.1: Equipping enough pieces of a set activates bonuses.$(br2)Example implemented: $(l)Dragon Set$() (2/4/6-piece effects).
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.elites.1: Vanilla variant elites drop accessories and spawn via biome modifiers.$(br2)Tip: gear up from common drops, then hunt elites for quality upgrades.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.chests.1: Vanilla structure chests can also contain accessories.$(br2)Check dungeons, strongholds, and ruins early on.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.weight.1: Weight limits how much you can carry.$(br2)$(li)Base cap ~120 (configurable)$(li)+2 per player level$(li)~60% safe threshold: slowdown starts$(li)~85% warning: faster hunger drain
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.weight.2: When overweight, speed can drop up to ~50%. When overloaded, hunger drain can reach ~2x.$(br2)Backpacks may raise the cap in future updates.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.forge_ta: The forge table handles growth and recycling for equipment.$(br2)Its material loop is split into four actions:$(li)Enhance$(li)Attribute Essence$(li)Reroll$(li)Smash
Enhancing needs 1 type essence and 1~10 matching rank shards.$(br2)Each successful enhancement adds 1 level; attribute essence also consumes one enhancement step.

Normal reroll only re-rolls base affixes and keeps enhancement layers. Advanced reroll re-rolls both base and enhancement numbers, but tends toward stronger results.$(br2)Lock stones can lock up to 2 affixes at once.

Smashing destroys the item, but returns materials already spent: rank shards have about a 50% return rate, and type essences return independently at 25% per piece.$(br2)Reroll stones are not returned.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.material: Materials are split into three main groups:$(li)Type Essences$(li)Rank Shards$(li)Reroll Stones$(br2)Rank shards match accessory rarities exactly and determine enhancement success.
Attribute essence adds a new base affix to equipment that does not already have that stat.$(br2)It does not add an extra affix slot, but it does consume one enhancement level.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.controls: $(l)K$() accessory screen: equip/swap.$(br)$(l)J$() attributes panel: inspect stats.$(br2)Tooltip borders are colored by rarity.
patchouli.evolutionary_mod.page.troubles: $(l)K does nothing?$()$(br)Leave chat, or check keybinds under the evolutionary_mod category.$(br2)$(l)Not sure what to equip?$()$(br)Compare values with J before swapping.
